metadata.benchmark_phase: Phase 6b — Comprehensive Platform Security Wire Battery

test_results.details: Evaluated 380 matrix cells across 76 operations x 5 roles. Statuses: 2xx=94, 401=71, 403=79, 404=48, 422=71, 5xx=3. Three 500s documented under DEFECT-API-02 (missing ProjectMember.user eager-load on GET /projects/{id}). Consistent role segregation verified.
100% of cross-tenant IDOR probes blocked (20/20) across all 10 resource types with HTTP 403/404.
Canary sensor actively targeted over wire (9 probes rejected); 0 canary hits verified; temporary bench attach/detach proved.
Documented Gap (DEFECT-AUTH-03 / P2): POST /api/v1/auth/login lacks rate limiting. Token lifetime (60m) and uniform error responses verified.
Mass assignment strictly blocked (403); zero 500 errors across 5 fuzzed endpoints; input validation robust.
API tamper blocked (404/405); DB role UPDATE rolled back cleanly (0 persisted); live audit chain valid (1597 entries).
All 5 prod containers unprivileged; zero docker.sock mounts; DB and Redis isolated without host port publish.
HTML report generated safely; markup escaped; directory traversal download blocked.
npm audit completed (2 total vulns: critical=1, high=1); pip-audit and container image scanners Not Tested (binaries not installed, installs prohibited).
10/10 adversarial prompt injection vectors withstood by live Azure GPT-5.6 gateway (0 overrides, 0 unauthorized dispatches). Total Tokens: 1526.
